question: How long has Cedar Ridge been in business?
answer: Cedar Ridge Comfort Systems is a family-owned heating and cooling company serving the Maple Falls area since 2004.

question: Are your technicians licensed and certified?
answer: Yes. Cedar Ridge holds Ohio HVAC contractor license OH-HVAC-48213. All 18 of our service technicians are NATE-certified and EPA Section 608 certified, and every technician is background-checked and drug-tested.

question: Are you insured?
answer: Yes. Cedar Ridge carries $2 million in general liability insurance and workers' compensation coverage for all employees.

question: What are your business hours?
answer: Our office and standard service hours are Monday-Friday 7:00 AM-6:00 PM and Saturday 8:00 AM-2:00 PM. We are closed Sundays for routine service. Emergency service is available 24/7 through our emergency line at (555) 014-2299.

question: Are you open on holidays?
answer: The office is closed on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. The 24/7 emergency line remains available, and holiday visits are billed at the after-hours rate.

question: How do I book an appointment?
answer: Call (555) 014-2200 during business hours or request a visit through the website. Our team confirms the appointment and a 2-hour arrival window by phone or text.

question: Do you offer same-day service?
answer: Same-day service is usually available for repair calls booked before 12:00 PM on weekdays in our core service area, depending on technician availability. Same-day service is not guaranteed in extended service ZIP codes.

question: How long is the arrival window?
answer: We give a 2-hour arrival window, and the technician sends a text about 30 minutes before arriving.

question: Do I need to be home for the appointment?
answer: An adult (18 or older) must be present to authorize work and provide access to indoor equipment. If the technician cannot access the equipment, the missed appointment fee may apply.

question: How much does a service call cost?
answer: A standard-hours diagnostic visit is $89. The fee is waived if you approve and complete the recommended repair during the same visit. After-hours, weekend and holiday diagnostics are $169. Comfort Club members pay no diagnostic fee during standard hours and $99 after hours.

question: Do you charge by the hour?
answer: No. We use upfront, flat-rate pricing. The technician diagnoses the problem and gives you the price before any work begins, so you can approve or decline.

question: Can you give me a price over the phone?
answer: We can share our published prices and typical ranges, such as the $89 diagnostic visit. An exact repair price requires a diagnosis, and replacement prices require a free in-home estimate and written quote.

question: Is there an extra charge for my area?
answer: Homes in our extended service ZIP codes have a $35 trip fee per visit. There is no trip fee in our core service area.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept cash, personal checks, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover and ACH bank transfer. Payment for repairs is due when the work is completed.

question: Do you offer financing?
answer: Yes, financing is available on approved credit for installations over $3,000 through our lending partner, Keystone Home Finance. Options include 0% APR for 18 months or 9.99% APR for up to 120 months. Terms are subject to credit approval.

question: What brands do you repair?
answer: We repair and maintain all major brands, including Carrier, Bryant, Trane, American Standard, Lennox, Rheem, Ruud, Goodman, Amana, Daikin, York, Heil, Mitsubishi Electric, Fujitsu, Aerotherm and Northline.

question: What brands do you install?
answer: We are an authorized dealer for Aerotherm central AC, furnaces and heat pumps, and Northline ductless mini-splits and cold-climate heat pumps.

question: Do you work on boilers or geothermal systems?
answer: No. We do not service boilers, hydronic radiant heating, geothermal heat pumps or oil furnaces. We can provide a referral on request.

question: Do you repair window air conditioners?
answer: No. We do not repair window or portable air conditioners.

question: Do you install or repair water heaters?
answer: No. Cedar Ridge does not offer water heater or plumbing services.

question: Do you service commercial buildings?
answer: Yes. We service light commercial rooftop units and split systems up to 25 tons in our core service area and most extended ZIP codes. Commercial service is not available in Riverton (45869) or Wapello Crossing (45895).

question: How often should my system be serviced?
answer: We recommend a cooling tune-up each spring and a heating tune-up each fall. Heat pumps should be serviced twice a year because they run in both seasons.

question: How often should I change my air filter?
answer: Check 1-inch filters monthly and replace them every 1-3 months. Thicker 4-5 inch media filters typically last 6-12 months. Replace sooner if you have pets, allergies or recent construction dust.

question: What filter rating should I use?
answer: For most homes we recommend a MERV 8-11 filter. Higher MERV ratings can restrict airflow in some systems, so ask your technician before using MERV 13 or above.

question: What is the Comfort Club?
answer: The Comfort Club is our maintenance membership. Basic is $16.95 per month or $189 per year and includes a cooling and a heating tune-up each year, no diagnostic fee during standard hours, $99 after-hours diagnostics, priority scheduling and 15% off repairs. Premium is $24.95 per month or $279 per year and adds a second system, an annual drain line treatment and 20% off repairs.

question: Can I cancel my Comfort Club membership?
answer: Yes. Monthly memberships can be canceled anytime with 30 days notice. Annual memberships canceled early receive a prorated refund minus the regular price of any services already used.

question: Do you warranty your repairs?
answer: Yes. Repairs come with a 2-year labor warranty. Parts we supply carry the manufacturer's parts warranty, and we guarantee parts we supply for at least 1 year. See our Warranty Policy for conditions.

question: Is my system still under warranty?
answer: Coverage depends on your equipment's manufacturer, model, install date and registration status, and on the work performed. We can't confirm coverage in chat. Our office can look it up with your serial number or invoice number.

question: Do you register my new equipment warranty?
answer: Yes. For systems we install, we register the manufacturer warranty on your behalf within 30 days of installation.

question: How long does a new system installation take?
answer: Most central AC or furnace replacements are completed in one day. Heat pump systems typically take 1-2 days. Ductless mini-splits take about one day per one or two zones.

question: Is the replacement estimate free?
answer: Yes. In-home replacement estimates are free and take about 60-90 minutes. Written quotes are valid for 30 days.

question: Do you pull permits?
answer: Yes. We obtain all required permits for installations and schedule the inspection. City or county permit fees are passed through at cost plus a $45 permit administration fee.

question: Can you recharge my R-22 system?
answer: No. R-22 is no longer produced, and we do not offer R-22 recharges. We can diagnose the system and provide a free replacement consultation.

question: What should I do if I smell gas?
answer: Leave the home immediately with everyone, including pets. Do not turn lights or appliances on or off, and do not use phones inside. From a safe distance, call your gas utility's emergency number or 911. Call us only after the gas utility has made the home safe.

question: My carbon monoxide alarm is going off. What should I do?
answer: Get everyone outside into fresh air immediately and call 911. Do not go back inside until the fire department says it is safe. After that, call our emergency line at (555) 014-2299 to have your heating equipment inspected.

question: What counts as an emergency?
answer: We treat no heat in cold weather, no cooling in extreme heat, water leaking from equipment, and burning smells (after you have turned the system off) as emergencies. Gas leaks must be handled by your gas utility or 911 first.

question: Why is my AC running but not cooling?
answer: Check that the thermostat is set to Cool and below room temperature, replace a dirty filter, and make sure the outdoor unit is running. If you see ice on the refrigerant lines, turn the system off and call us. Do not attempt refrigerant or electrical repairs yourself.

question: Why is water leaking from my indoor unit?
answer: A clogged condensate drain line is the most common cause. Turn the system off at the thermostat to limit water damage and schedule a service visit. Condensate drain line clearing is $149.

question: Is it normal for my heat pump to steam in winter?
answer: Yes. Heat pumps run a defrost cycle in cold weather, which can produce steam or vapor from the outdoor unit for a few minutes. This is normal. Call us if the outdoor unit is fully encased in ice.

question: What is your cancellation policy?
answer: You can cancel or reschedule free of charge with at least 24 hours notice. Cancellations with less than 24 hours notice, or visits where the technician cannot access the equipment, may be charged a $49 missed appointment fee. Comfort Club members get one waiver per membership year.

question: Do you have a satisfaction guarantee?
answer: Yes. If you are not satisfied with a repair, tell us within 30 days and we will return to make it right at no additional charge.

question: How often should ducts be cleaned?
answer: We typically recommend duct cleaning every 3-5 years, or sooner after renovations, pest problems or if you notice visible dust and debris at the vents.

question: Do you offer air purifiers?
answer: Yes. We install UV air purifiers ($795), media air cleaners ($650), whole-home humidifiers ($895) and whole-home dehumidifiers ($1,850), including installation.

question: Are there rebates or tax credits for a new system?
answer: Rebates and tax incentives change often. Our Rebates and Incentives Guide lists current offers, and your comfort advisor will apply eligible rebates on your quote. Cedar Ridge does not provide tax advice. Please consult a tax professional about tax credits.

question: Where are you located?
answer: Our office is at 1200 Timberline Road, Maple Falls, OH. We serve homes and businesses in the Maple Falls area. Check the service area list for your ZIP code.
